## 更新内容

- 新增一级模块「售前工作台」，与招投标模块独立，支持售前项目创建、检索、编辑、删除和元数据管理。
- 新增项目级售前工作流，覆盖项目资料、客户材料、客户分析、调研准备、方案架构、图表草稿和汇报材料页纲，产出结果按项目保存。
- 客户材料支持文件导入和手动录入；当客户无法提供材料时，可基于项目资料和补充描述继续推进客户分析与方案准备。
- 新增售前方案 Word 导出能力，导出过程展示进度，完成后显示导出路径，并支持点击打开所在目录。
- 优化售前方案 Word 文档格式，包含封面、目录、正文页码、标题层级、图片尺寸约束和目录字体样式。
- 汇报材料模块保留页纲生成与页纲导出，便于用户将结构化页纲交给其他 AI 或演示文稿工具继续制作 PPT。
- 优化技术方案「扩写改写」页面布局，突出选择扩写范围和右侧设置区域，减少内容叠加并提升操作效率。
- 优化售前工作台多处交互细节，包括项目进入逻辑、进度展示、导出记录、路径跳转和预览区域布局。

## What's Changed

- Added a new top-level Presales Workbench module independent from the bidding workflows, with project creation, search, editing, deletion, and metadata management.
- Added project-scoped presales workflows covering project information, customer materials, customer analysis, research preparation, solution architecture, diagram drafts, and presentation outline assets.
- Customer materials can now be imported from files or entered manually; when customer documents are unavailable, users can continue analysis and solution preparation with project information and supplemental notes.
- Added Word export for presales proposals, including progress feedback, exported path display, and one-click access to the output folder.
- Improved presales proposal Word formatting with cover page, table of contents, body page numbering, heading hierarchy, image size constraints, and TOC font styling.
- Kept presentation outline generation and outline export so users can continue slide creation in external AI or presentation tools.
- Improved the Technical Plan expansion/rewrite page layout by making the expansion range and settings panels more prominent and easier to operate.
- Refined multiple Presales Workbench interactions, including project entry behavior, progress indicators, export records, path navigation, and preview layout.
